# Load the sleep and recovery data

merged_df = pd.merge(smartphone_usage_df, social_media_usage_df, on='date')

corr_smartphone_recovery = merged_df['smartphone_usage'].corr(merged_df['recovery_score'])
corr_social_media_sleep = merged_df['social_media_usage'].corr(merged_df['sleep_duration'])
corr_social_media_recovery = merged_df['social_media_usage'].corr(merged_df['recovery_score'])
# Print the results

print("Correlation between smartphone usage and recovery score:", corr_smartphone_recovery)
